text: RESULTS: The patient has an erythematous plaque with areas of crusting, oozing, and irregular borders. Palpation reveals lesions are firm, non-tender, with no warmth; regional lymph nodes are normal. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC). The biopsy findings of nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within follicle-bearing epithelium, combined with the clinical presentation of a firm, crusted, erythematous plaque, are diagnostic for SCC. Given the negative STD panel, infectious etiologies like syphilis have been ruled out.
